biotools.summary: Histo-Miner is a deep learning pipeline that performs nucleus segmentation and classification and tumor region segmentation on H&E whole-slide images of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, producing tissue morphology feature vectors usable for downstream tasks such as predicting immunotherapy response.
